tc_int_05.long_query: Please provide a comprehensive and detailed analysis of CareSource's approach to member health management, care coordination, and policy compliance. Cover the following areas in depth: (1) Describe the key principles underpinning CareSource's Medicaid managed care model and how they align with state and federal regulatory requirements. (2) Explain how CareSource coordinates care across primary care physicians, specialists, and behavioral health providers to ensure continuity of care for complex members. (3) Outline CareSource's approach to utilization management, including prior authorization workflows, concurrent review processes, and retrospective review criteria. (4) Detail how CareSource handles grievances and appeals for members and providers, including required timelines and escalation paths. (5) Describe the quality improvement programs in place, such as HEDIS measures, CAHPS surveys, and NCQA accreditation activities, and how performance results are used to drive clinical improvements. (6) Explain how CareSource addresses Social Determinants of Health (SDOH), including programs targeting food insecurity, housing instability, and transportation barriers. (7) Discuss the role of care management and disease management programs for high-risk populations such as members with diabetes, hypertension, COPD, and serious mental illness. (8) Provide an overview of CareSource's pharmacy benefit management strategy, including formulary design, step therapy protocols, and medication adherence initiatives. (9) Describe how CareSource ensures provider network adequacy, monitors network performance, and manages provider credentialing and contracting. (10) Summarize the technology and data analytics capabilities CareSource uses to identify gaps in care, predict high-risk members, and drive proactive outreach.
